name: fastwrite
description:
fastwrite is an AI writing assistant help you writing your assignments, Bachelor's or Master's thesis or papers.

This connector gives Claude access to your fastwrite source library, so you can work with your own literature directly in Claude.

To supercharge your Claude, you can upload your academic sources and enable it to:
- Chat with your library to get an overview
- Search your sources for specific information
- Back its claims with verified citation links
- Discover new literature beyond your own library through our paper database with 20 million papers
- Search the web for further relevant papers

Get started: create your free fastwrite account, upload your literature and connect your sources to Claude!

_published_faq.name: How do I add fastwrite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add fastwrite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.fastwrite.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the fastwrite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: fastwrite provides these MCP tools: build_cite_links, find_in_sources, get_source_pages, list_students_library, search_external_papers, search_student_sources, and web_paper_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to fastwrite?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to fastwrite in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
fastwrite requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
fastwrite is developed by fastwrite.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
